source: due2-native: a refinement on a policy-level action is read in its own policy's data space (decisions/0050, #154)
notes: Authored for due2; no origin result. Two policies by different parties, one corpus (conformance/README.md). ex:offer states its one action on the policy, use refined to research purposes, and normalisation gives it to ex:useA (odrl-compound-to-atomic-normalization.md §6.2). ex:partner refines the same way, but on its rule rather than the policy, and its own scheme puts dpv:Marketing below dpv:Research. The refinement is ex:offer's, and the atoms of one policy share its data space, so it is read in ex:offer's data space alone (decisions/0050 #1, #7). Until #154, clingo-i gave a policy-level refinement no data space and read it in every policy, so scenarios 1, 2, and 3 declined as read apart by their policies (clingo-i at 02139b2). Scenario 2 is law L11 (due2-workflows.md §8): ex:offer alone gives the same answer. due2-core binds odrl:purpose to the request (due2-profiles.md §3). Each policy names the due2 profile and states odrl:purpose due2:conceptScheme <scheme>, the scheme its odrl:purpose reads (decisions/0015).

scenarios.name: research is below research in the offer's scheme

expected.why: In ex:offer's scheme, dpv:ScientificResearch is below dpv:Research, so the refinement on ex:offer's action is T, and so is every part of ex:useA (due2-workflows.md §5.2): Permit.

scenarios.name: the partner's edge does not reach the offer's refinement

expected.why: ex:offer's scheme has no edge from dpv:Marketing to dpv:Research; only ex:partner's has, and it is not in ex:offer's data space (decisions/0050 #1). ex:useA's action part is F, and ex:useB's target part is F: NotApplicable.

scenarios.name: the partner's edge widens its own refinement

expected.why: In ex:partner's own scheme dpv:Marketing is below dpv:Research, so ex:useB's refinement is T and every part of ex:useB is T: Permit. ex:useA's target part is F.

The request gives no purpose, so ex:useA's refinement is U, its part missing (decisions/0016 #2; due2-profiles.md §3, Resolution). The permission is completed alone: Indeterminate, NotApplicable..Permit. ex:useB's target part is F, so its parts are not reported.
